channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Woman from central Vietnam returns mistaken bank transfer of over $19,000
item.description: A woman from Quang Ngai Province, central Vietnam has returned more than US$19,000 mistakenly transferred to her bank account by a stranger, with assistance from local police just one day before the Lunar New Year (Tet).

item.title: [LIVE BLOG] Fireworks light up the skies across Vietnam to welcome Lunar New Year
item.description: Fireworks lit up the skies across Vietnam as people gathered in cities and provinces nationwide to welcome the Lunar New Year 2026, celebrating with vibrant displays, cheers, and a festive atmosphere at the stroke of midnight.

item.title: Live video: Fireworks light up Ho Chi Minh City for 2026 Lunar New Year
item.description: Ho Chi Minh City launches fireworks at 17 locations on the 2026 Lunar New Year’s Eve, including four high-altitude displays combined with 13 low-level shows.

item.title: A quiet bridge: Linking Vietnam and the world
item.description: In late 2025, international technology, finance, and media corporations held working sessions with Da Nang authorities to explore investment opportunities in the city’s proposed International Financial Center. A figure familiar to overseas Vietnamese communities was among the delegation: Peter Hong (Nguyen Hong Hue).

item.title: Filipino teacher experiences heartwarming, family-centered Tet in Vietnam
item.description: What surprises me the most about Tet, or the Lunar New Year holiday, in Vietnam is how deeply family-centered it is. Everything seems to pause – work, business, even the busy pace of the city – just so people can go home and be with their families.

item.title: Vietnamese returns home through music
item.description: After years working in the American music industry, Dr. Tran Tuan An returned home carrying little more than a guitar, years of training and a determination to help strengthen Vietnam’s music scene.

item.title: Vietnam International Finance Center in Ho Chi Minh City prioritizes institutional reform: CEO
item.description: The CEO of the Vietnam International Finance Center in Ho Chi Minh City (VIFC-HCMC) stated that VIFC's success in the next 3-5 years should first be measured by the level of institutional maturity, followed by the depth of the market.

item.title: Vietnam’s Party General Secretary To Lam to visit US for Gaza Board of Peace meeting
item.description: General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam To Lam will travel to the United States for a three-day working visit to attend the inaugural session of the Gaza Board of Peace, according to the Vietnamese Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

item.title: Ho Chi Minh City students introduced to responsible, sustainable fashion consumption
item.description: From learning how to recycle old clothes to bringing end-of-life garments to collection points, students in Ho Chi Minh City are being guided toward responsible fashion consumption from an early age.
